reason: The disk and hot inner orbits suggest a direct route toward the inner rocky mixture.
expectation: This should establish the hot inner region of the disk, where rocky material can persist.

effect: The disk combines with the young Sun to establish the hot inner region; hot orbits were not the right partner.
reaction: The automatic correction was useful, though the intended heating mechanism was not obvious from the pair I tried.
reason: Rock-forming dust is the most direct available ingredient for the inner disk’s rocky mixture.

choice.combine: A disk with a hot inner region

expectation: Heating the dust in the inner disk should advance the rocky mixture.

effect: Hot inner orbits transform the heated disk region into vapor; the rock-forming dust was not the next partner.
reaction: I was surprised that the grains evaporate before the rocky mixture forms.
reason: Escaping radiation suggests a way to cool the hot vapor so solids can condense again.
expectation: The vapor should cool and begin forming solid material.

effect: Cooling the vapor produced refractory mineral grains, providing a solid ingredient for the inner disk.
reaction: It is satisfying to see solids re-form after the earlier evaporation.
reason: Combining the newly condensed minerals with rock-forming dust seems a plausible route to the rocky mixture.
expectation: The grains and dust should contribute to an inner-disk rocky mixture.

effect: The refractory grains and rock-forming dust formed a loose rocky aggregate, advancing the inner-disk mixture.
reaction: It is satisfying that grains with different histories can join together.
reason: Iron-bearing metal grains are a plausible remaining ingredient for the inner disk’s rocky mixture.
expectation: The metal grains should join the rocky aggregate.

effect: The aggregate needed brief intense heating, producing molten droplets rather than incorporating metal yet.
reaction: The automatic correction clarified the next stage; leaving the heating mechanism open is informative.
reason: Escaping radiation can cool the molten droplets back into solids.
expectation: The droplets should cool and solidify into rocky grains.

effect: The molten droplets cooled into chondrules, providing solid rocky particles for the inner-disk mixture.
reaction: Their preserved heating and cooling textures are an interesting record of their history.
reason: Iron-bearing metal grains are still available and may complete the rocky mixture with the cooled chondrules.
expectation: The metal grains and chondrules should form a mixed inner-disk material.

effect: The chondrules and metal grains formed the rocky mixture, completing the inner-disk goal.
reaction: The distinction between mixed ingredients and an actual planet is useful.
reason: Ice-mantled dust and cold outer orbits are the clearest available pairing for storing ice beyond the snow line.
expectation: The cold outer region should preserve the dust’s ice beyond the snow line.

effect: Ice-mantled dust sublimated in hot inner orbits, leaving water vapor rather than stored ice.
reaction: The automatic detour highlights the contrast between warm and cold regions.
reason: The vapor’s available partners are unclear, so checking them should reveal how to proceed toward storing ice.
expectation: Inspection may show a way to move or cool the water toward the outer disk.

alternatives.reason: The cold region might let water freeze, but I am unsure this is a direct pairing.

effect: Water vapor combined with cold outer orbits to form recondensed outer-disk ice, showing that water can be transported and reprocessed in the disk.
reaction: The warm-to-cold detour made the movement of water more concrete.
reason: The ice has formed, but the remaining step needed to store it is unclear, so checking its partners is useful.
expectation: Inspection should reveal how the ice can be stored beyond the snow line.

effect: The inspection automatically combined recondensed ice with ice-mantled dust, completing the outer-disk store and the chapter’s goals.
reaction: It was satisfying to see inherited and reprocessed ice come together.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following water from sublimation to recondensation made its movement and processing in the disk concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated automatic corrections early on made the precise required pairings somewhat confusing, even when the physical direction seemed reasonable.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the inner-disk grains evaporated before cooling and condensing again.

arbitrary.text: Combining ice-mantled dust with cold outer orbits seemed natural, but instead the game automatically sent it into hot orbits; that required detour felt somewhat arbitrary.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how these rocky and icy materials become larger bodies, especially after learning how differently they were processed.
